title: Automatically Finding Reward Model Biases
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focuses on a general methodology for automatically discovering biases in reward models, with examples including formatting errors (e.g., redundant spacing) and hallucinated content.
findings: The paper did not produce any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study.
